subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain a default-off silent audio preflight history mode for `requireMention` channels, and what consent, retention, cost, and visibility limits should it enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested behavior intentionally processes and retains speech from messages that did not invoke the bot, which is a product/security boundary decision rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Approve scoped Discord policy
options.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Wait for shared media-history policy
options.body: Keep this as product input but avoid a Discord-only knob until maintainers define cross-channel silent media retention semantics.

options.title: Decline silent transcription
options.body: Keep current mention-gated behavior if maintainers decide unmentioned speech should not be transcribed or retained without direct invocation.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped Discord policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history points to the broadest recent ownership of Discord preflight/history/config-adjacent behavior and the adjacent product decision on broadening Discord audio preflight.
